hypothesis: If fresh admission alone opens the relative throughput deficit, the published-to-reference rate ratio should fall across first arrival and recover after last completion.
limits: The samples within one run are dependent. Small traced sets, fixed phase order, variable offered fresh rates and short flanks limit causal interpretation. Interface drops and per-process CPU/runnable time for the four subwindows are unavailable. No peer qualification.
method: Same 32 already-warm sockets. Compare fully contained cumulative-byte sample spans on either side of first fresh request start and final fresh response completion. Use 350 ms on each side and inspect 100/200 ms. Each invocation runs bulk-only, then 240 (original) or 160 (release) sequential fresh probes, then bulk-only. The two paths are observed in separate invocations. Keep each historical cohort separate.
tier: Offline raw replay of historical VM diagnostics
